feed.text: Felt a tremor? sisma shows what just shook, where and how strong, with live data from USGS, EMSC, GeoNet and JMA. Free on Android.
feed.alt: sisma on Google Play, headline "Earthquakes as they happen": a phone showing the live list of recent earthquakes, each with its magnitude badge, place, time and distance.

detail.text: Magnitude, depth, time and distance from you for every earthquake, plus whether an agency has reviewed it. Everything at a glance in sisma.
detail.alt: sisma on Google Play, headline "Every detail at a glance": a phone showing one earthquake's details, with magnitude, depth, date, time, distance, country, coordinates, review status and source.

map.text: The whole world on one map: live earthquakes and tectonic plate boundaries, from the planet down to street level. Free on Android.
map.alt: sisma on Google Play, headline "The whole world on one map": a phone showing a world map with recent earthquakes as coloured pins.

region.text: Zoom in on any quake to see the others nearby and follow aftershocks as they come in, then share it as a picture with a map.
region.alt: sisma on Google Play, headline "Zoom in on any quake": a phone showing a close-up map around one earthquake, with its summary card below.

globe.text: Spin a live 3D globe of the world's earthquakes and watch the Pacific Ring of Fire light up. Free in sisma for Android.
globe.alt: sisma on Google Play, headline "Spin the live 3D globe": a phone showing a 3D globe covered in earthquake pins around the Pacific.

depth.text: Switch the globe to depth view and see how deep each earthquake struck, from the shallow crust to hundreds of kilometres down.
depth.alt: sisma on Google Play, headline "See how deep they strike": a phone showing the 3D globe in depth view, with earthquake pins coloured by depth.

science.text: How do earthquakes work? Illustrated guides on plates, faults, waves and magnitude, plus long-form In Depth articles, in 10 languages.
science.alt: sisma on Google Play, headline "The science made simple": a phone showing the illustrated plate tectonics guide, with a diagram of an oceanic plate sinking beneath a continent.

alerts.text: Push alerts for the earthquakes that matter to you: your places, countries, a minimum magnitude, quiet hours. Try sisma+ free for 3 days.
alerts.alt: sisma on Google Play, headline "Alerts that matter": a phone showing an earthquake push notification, the push alerts setting and a history of recent alerts.

pulse.text: The pulse of a living planet: every earthquake reported by four seismic agencies, in a live feed, map and 3D globe. Free, no ads.
pulse.alt: sisma.io feature graphic: the sisma.io logo and the line "The pulse of a living planet" over a dark rock texture glowing red and blue.

felt.text: Did you feel it? Report the shaking in the first hours after a quake and see where others felt it, shown only as anonymous counts by area.
felt.alt: sisma.io feature graphic: the sisma.io logo and the line "The pulse of a living planet" over a dark rock texture glowing red and blue.
